name: Camping-Stadler
beschreibung:
=== description ===

Camping-Stadler is located along the shoreline of the Waginger See in the Upper Bavarian Alpine foothills, about 20 kilometers west of Traunstein. The campsite provides direct lake access and is surrounded by meadows and forests. Guests can choose from pitches for RVs, tents, and fixed rental accommodations. The amenities include sanitary facilities, a small shop, and a gastro establishment right by the lakeside. The village of Petting itself features a beach area and serves as a starting point for hikes in the Rupertiwinkel region.
